clean_epoch_rule: reject if >=3 EEG channels ptp>200uV or any ptp>300uV or any std<0.5uV
filter: 4th-order Butterworth zero-phase SOS 0.5-45Hz on full five-minute signal
identity: release-local EDF ID matched to States.xlsx Sheet1 column A; diagnosis from column B
missing_EDF_unit_assumption: Physical dimensions are blank in all 61 files. Interpret original numerical physical values as microvolts (uV), supported by +/-335 calibration and plausible EEG amplitudes. Not directly confirmed by recording authors.
note: No ICA/ASR or other corrections; acquisition/reference may differ from original OpenNeuro derivatives; no classification
participant_id: release-aware, not proof of cross-release unique person
quality_window_selection: fixed first five minutes for everyone; no sliding or optimization
unit: MNE EDF voltage units converted to microvolts
